notes: Four distinct movable parts are manipulated. The two upper-cabinet leaves are treated as separate events because they are opened and closed in adjacent actions. Their closing order is partially obscured, but both off transitions occur during approximately frames 312–328.
scene_description: A compact kitchen containing a refrigerator, range, upper cabinets, and drawer banks. After an initial camera survey, the user opens both separate doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator and one drawer on each side of the range, then closes all four parts.
